Front: Paano gumawa ng custom hook sa React?
Back: function useCounter(initial = 0) { const [count, setCount] = useState(initial); return { count, increment: () => setCount(c => c + 1) }; }

Front: Paano i-reuse ang custom hook sa ibang components?
Back: const { count, increment } = useCounter(0); — tawagin lang ang hook at i-destructure ang returned values

Front: Paano gumawa ng useFetch custom hook?
Back: function useFetch(url) { useEffect(() => { fetch(url).then(r => r.json()).then(setData); }, [url]); return data; }

Front: Paano i-combine ang maraming hooks sa custom hook?
Back: function useAuth() { const user = useContext(AuthContext); const logout = useLogout(); return { user, logout }; }

Front: Paano malaman kung kailangan gumawa ng custom hook?
Back: Kapag mayroong duplicated stateful logic sa maraming components, i-extract bilang custom hook
